policy: All overrides must have inventory entries; existing entries remain pending evidence-based review. This inventory is not a claim that each pin is necessary.

overrides.name: uuid
overrides.reason: Temporary compatibility experiment: force UUID 14.0.3 globally to eliminate vulnerable UUID 8.3.2 in @lhci/cli. Lighthouse CI declares an older range; passing real Lighthouse job required before acceptance.
overrides.removalCriteria: If Lighthouse fails, revert this experiment. If it passes, review upstream compatibility and future targeted replacement; do not interpret passing once as long-term support.

overrides.name: follow-redirects
overrides.reason: Security advisories GHSA-q3jh-wrc6-jgq8 and GHSA-8r9p-f939-6h3c affect 1.16.0; axios introduces follow-redirects into frontend and backoffice.
overrides.removalCriteria: Remove only after axios and dependency resolution guarantee follow-redirects >=1.16.1 without override and full security CI passes.
